transcript.text: Here's my technical production finding. The electrician load test I conducted on the gallery circuit allocated to 'Afterimage Corridor' found that the circuit supports exactly two LED projection units totaling no more than 300 watts. The current installation draft calls for four LED projection units, so we have a significant capacity shortfall — the circuit can only handle half of the planned projection load. I'm still waiting on the signed load sheet from the building engineer before I can enter the final result in the production file, but the test result itself is clear. Technical production cannot sign off on the current draft as specified.

transcript.text: Here's my music rights finding. I confirmed with the publisher that only the 42-second excerpt of the composition 'Night Transit' is cleared for this installation. I also want to flag that I have not yet attached the email confirmation to the rights register — that's still a pending item on my end. Until the draft is revised to reflect the once-per-visitor-cycle requirement and I've filed the confirmation, music rights cannot sign off on the current draft as specified.
